headline: Redefining world class.
publicTriad: World class is not a status we claim. It is a capacity we give.
The highest standard should not remain rare. It should become infrastructure.
World class by what we give the world.

websiteSection.title: World class is a responsibility to give capacity back to the world.
websiteSection.description: For Boundary First Labs, excellence becomes meaningful when it leaves behind better distinctions, usable methods, visible consequence, and reachable repair.

claimCeiling: An institutional commitment and conceptual framing, not a certification of quality, a hierarchy of human worth, or proof that a formal class of worlds has been established.
firewalls: Class without caste. Distinction without domination.
A person is not exhausted by any software or institutional representation.
A useful analogy is not an established formal equivalence.
